title: Operate a Tipper Station using the self-contained tipper HMI (Ready to Tip) to dump tote contents to the chute
summary: At the operator station, use the self-contained tipper HMI to run a tip cycle: clamp the tote from the AGV, actuate the tipping arm to dump contents onto the chute, and place the tote back onto the AGV. Use the station’s operator E-stop and the “I’m ready to tip” button to initiate the cycle.
when_to_use: Use when a tote is presented to the tipper at an operator station and you need to perform the tip cycle (clamp → dump to chute → return tote to the AGV) using the station’s self-contained tipper HMI.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the tip cycle using the self-contained tipper HMI and station controls (including operator E-stop).
safety_notes: If an E-stop is required for safety, do not continue the cycle.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (tipper station self-contained HMI)
Operator station controls including E-stop and the “ready to tip” button

system_preconditions: A tote is presented to the tipper (tote coming in from the AGV).
The station is set up for the tip cycle described (clamp tote, tip arm, dump to chute, then return tote).

visual_references.description: Training frame showing operator station tipper behavior (clamp tote from AGV → actuate tipping arm to dump onto chute → place tote back onto AGV) and mentions of self-contained HMI with operator E-stop and a button that says “I’m ready to tip.”

steps.title: Identify the self-contained tipper HMI for the operator station
steps.purpose: Ensure you are operating the correct station’s self-contained tipper controls.
steps.instruction: At the operator station, identify the self-contained tipper HMI for that station.
steps.expected_result: You have located the station’s self-contained tipper HMI used for operation and fault recovery.
steps.healthy_condition: The correct station’s tipper HMI is identified for the station where the tote is arriving.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confidently identify the correct station’s self-contained tipper HMI.

actions.label: Locate tipper HMI
actions.exact_action: Identify the self-contained tipper HMI for the station.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Each of the operator stations have two tippers... Self-contained HMI for operation and fault recovery.

steps.title: Confirm the operator safety control (E-stop) is available at the station
steps.purpose: Verify safety control availability before initiating the tip cycle.
steps.instruction: Confirm the operator safety control is present/available on the station (E-stop).
steps.expected_result: The station’s operator E-stop is present/available for use.
steps.healthy_condition: You can access the operator E-stop at the operator station.
steps.failure_condition: The operator E-stop is not available or cannot be accessed.

actions.label: Check E-stop availability
actions.exact_action: Confirm the operator safety control is present/available on the station (E-stop).

stop_or_escalate_if: If an E-stop is required for safety, do not continue the cycle.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Operators equipped with Estop and ready to tip buttons.

steps.title: Verify tote is presented and station is set up for the tip cycle
steps.purpose: Ensure the mechanical sequence can run: clamp tote → tip arm dump → return tote.
steps.instruction: Ensure a tote is presented to the tipper (tote coming in from the AGV) and that the station is set up for the tip cycle described (clamp tote, tip arm, dump to chute, then return tote).
steps.expected_result: A tote is at the station for tipping, and the station is ready to perform the clamp → dump → return sequence.
steps.healthy_condition: A tote is coming in from the AGV to the tipper at the operator station.
steps.failure_condition: No tote is presented to the tipper, or the station is not set up to perform the clamp → dump → return sequence.

actions.label: Check tote arrival and readiness
actions.exact_action: Ensure a tote is presented to the tipper (tote coming in from the AGV) and that the station is set up for the tip cycle described (clamp tote, tip arm, dump to chute, then return tote).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: An HB will come in, the tipper will be clamped... Places tote back onto AGV.

steps.title: Press “I’m ready to tip” on the tipper HMI to initiate the cycle
steps.purpose: Start the tip cycle using the station’s self-contained HMI control.
steps.instruction: On the tipper HMI, press the button that indicates you are ready to tip (“I’m ready to tip”).
steps.expected_result: The tip cycle is initiated from the tipper HMI using the “I’m ready to tip” button.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing the button, the station begins the clamp → dump → return behavior.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing the button does not result in the expected clamp → dump → return behavior.

actions.label: Initiate tip cycle
actions.exact_action: Press the button that indicates you are ready to tip (“I’m ready to tip”).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: HMI right as AE stop and then like a button that says I'm ready to tip...

steps.title: Observe the tipper cycle: clamp tote, dump to chute, return tote to AGV
steps.purpose: Confirm the mechanical sequence completes as described.
steps.instruction: Observe the tipper cycle behavior: the tipper clamps the tote from the AGV, actuates the tipping arm to dump contents onto the chute, and then places the tote back onto the AGV.
steps.expected_result: A successful tip cycle occurs: clamp tote from AGV → actuate tipping arm to dump contents onto chute → place tote back onto AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: You see the tote clamped, the tipping arm actuate to dump contents onto the chute, and the tote returned to the AGV.
steps.failure_condition: The tote does not clamp, the tipping arm does not actuate to dump, or the tote is not returned to the AGV as described.

actions.label: Watch cycle completion
actions.exact_action: Observe the tipper cycle behavior: the tipper clamps the tote from the AGV, actuates the tipping arm to dump contents onto the chute, and then places the tote back onto the AGV.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop the operation if the tote does not clamp, the tipping arm does not actuate to dump, or the tote is not returned to the AGV as described.
Escalate/stop if the station does not perform the clamp → tip/dump → return sequence described.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Tipper will clamp tote from AGV... actuators tip the arm to dump contents onto the chute... Places tote back onto AGV.

success_criteria: Tip cycle completes with the tote clamped from the AGV, tipping arm actuates to dump contents onto the chute, and tote is placed back onto the AGV.
healthy_conditions: Tote is presented to the tipper from the AGV.
After pressing “I’m ready to tip,” the station performs clamp → dump to chute → return to AGV.
failure_conditions: Station does not perform the clamp → tip/dump → return sequence described.
Tipping arm does not actuate to dump.
Tote is not returned to the AGV as described.
escalation_guidance: Escalate/stop if the station does not perform the clamp → tip/dump → return sequence described.
If an E-stop is required for safety, do not continue the cycle.
